responses.text: Noted: trip TR-4520, the two of you in Mirelake, and every meal must be nut free because of your partner's severe allergy. I have your lake walk ideas too.
Thanks: the winter market list and the train down from Brannock. I will keep the market budget in mind.
Noted your packing list and the restaurant ideas; asking each place about a nut-free kitchen is the right plan.
Thanks for the sights and the three day plans; they leave plenty of rest time.

Your trip TR-4520 is at the Mirelake Quay Hotel (HT-15), and its breakfast is nut free with a separate kitchen area, so it suits your partner's severe nut allergy. Mention the allergy at check-in too.
